wing: Physical SENS T5 transport evidence verification
question: Do independently read physical T5 bytes, exact bit-views, SHA-256 identities and raw timing samples substantiate the reported CPython transport measurements?
claim: Measures CPython T5 decode+encode versus exact-bit view with AB/BA repeats and rejects inconsistent hashes, typed widths, medians and fabricated claims. It does not measure SENS runtime, native speedup, or semantic-oracle parity.
reproduce: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_physical_t5_evidence_integrity.py -v && python3 scripts/benchmark-sens-physical.py --out-dir /tmp/sens-t5-evidence --reps 9 --iterations 300 && python3 benchmarks/evidence-integrity/verify_physical_t5.py --report /tmp/sens-t5-evidence/physical-t5.json --expected-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD)
